c74object.name: el.stutter~
c74object.digest: Algorithmic buffer loop stutterer and repeater
c74object.description:
el.stutter~ is an algorithmic buffer repeater and loop stutterer (precursor to el.chopper~). It continuously selects random slices from an audio buffer and repeats each slice for a randomized number of repetitions ("echos") with smooth envelope crossfades before picking the next slice. Loops can be locked to repeat continuously (lock_loop), manually re-triggered (bang, new_loop), modified on repetitions with random start and duration wander (rand_start, rand_dur), or saved and recalled from preset slots (store_loop, recall_loop). Double-clicking the object opens the referenced buffer~ display window.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (bang / messages): Control message inlet. Accepts commands to trigger new loops (bang, new_loop), lock playback (lock_loop), set loop boundaries (minloop, maxloop), set echo repetitions (min_echo, max_echo), configure random walk (rand_dur, rand_start), and manage presets (store_loop, recall_loop).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Left (or Mono) audio output signal.
Outlet 2 (signal): Right audio output signal (present when channel count is 2).

inlet.description: Receives trigger bangs to force new loop selections, as well as loop boundary, duration, and preset configuration messages.

outlet.description: Left or mono audio signal output from the buffer player.
Right channel audio signal output (active when channel count is 2).

objarg.name: buffer-name
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ to read from.

objarg.name: channel-count
objarg.description: The number of output channels to create (default: 2, range: 1 to 2).

objarg.name: minimum-loop-time
objarg.description: The lower bound for random loop durations in milliseconds (default: 20.0 ms).

objarg.name: maximum-loop-time
objarg.description: The upper bound for random loop durations in milliseconds (default: 200.0 ms).

objarg.name: taper-duration
objarg.description: Fade-in and fade-out smoothing taper duration in milliseconds (default: 2.0 ms).

method.name: bang
method.description: Immediately selects and crossfades into a new random loop slice.

method.name: lock_loop
method.description: When set to 1, locks the currently active loop so that it repeats indefinitely. When set to 0 (default), loops repeat for their random echo count before choosing a new segment.

method.name: max_echo
method.description: Sets the maximum number of repeats/echos played per random loop segment (default: 12).

method.name: maxloop
method.description: Sets the maximum duration in milliseconds for randomly chosen loops.

method.name: min_echo
method.description: Sets the minimum number of repeats/echos played per random loop segment (default: 2).

method.name: minloop
method.description: Sets the minimum duration in milliseconds for randomly chosen loops.

method.name: new_loop
method.description: Selects and begins playing a new random loop slice immediately (identical to bang).

method.name: rand_dur
method.description: Sets the random duration deviation factor applied upon loop repetition (range: 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: rand_start
method.digest: Set start time random deviation factor
method.description: Sets the random start position deviation factor applied upon loop repetition (range: 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: recall_loop
method.description: Recalls and begins playing the loop configuration previously stored in memory slot slot-index (0 to 1023).

method.name: set_loop
method.description: Explicitly sets the active loop start position and duration in sample frames.

method.name: show_loop
method.description: Prints the current loop start frame and sample length to the Max Console.

method.name: store_loop
method.description: Stores the current loop's start position and length into memory slot slot-index (0 to 1023).

method.name: taper
method.description: Sets the fade-in and fade-out duration of the segment smoothing envelope in milliseconds.
